notes: Modified cash basis school district. Trimmed pages: 1=p7 net position, 2=p8 activities, 3-4=p9-10 governmental funds (Total Governmental Funds column on p4), 5=p20 all-funds budget, 6=p21 GF receipts, 7=p22 GF disbursements, 8=p23 Depreciation, 9=p24 Activities, 10=p25 Nutrition, 11=p26 Special Building, 12-16=p27-31 Exhibit of operational expenses, 17=p32 Activities 2025, 18=p33 Activities 2024 (prior year, not recorded). School nutrition is shown by the report within governmental funds, so kept governmental. Beginning/ending cash = fund balances (cash basis). Total column shows no transfers (242,100 in and out eliminated in Reclassification column), so top-level transfers are null; transfers appear as detail other financing: General -137,100 nutrition, -55,000 activities, -50,000 depreciation (three lines 650/525/732 printed inside support-service and transportation lines, eliminated in the statement: statement support services 1,438,629.98 = schedule 1,488,629.98 - 50,000); receiving funds show +137,100, +55,000, +50,000 (cross-check ties). The SoA removed 5,000 from Pupils line (93,383.26) whereas the schedule prints it in 2200 library/technology; recorded as printed. General Fund detail uses the Exhibit (object detail), superseding p7 function lines; zero/dash lines omitted. Exhibit expenditure items sum to 3,835,122.40 = printed total 4,077,222.40 less 242,100 transfers. Local receipts split by SoA general receipts (property 2,111,964.18, motor vehicle, carline) plus license fees 949.60 and other 134.55 from p6. Support services split from pupil transportation via SoA. Activities per-account schedule used instead of the one-line activities budget schedule (p9); its receipts include the 55,000 transfer, handled with a contra line. Activities receipts accounts sum: gate passes receipts read as 12,896.00 (ties to balance 980.00). Budget comparison all funds (p5) not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-18 of 18 Correction (outside review): Activities per-account receipts for the three scholarship investment accounts (sum 39,756.01 = p9 1510 Interest) and 'Now interest' recategorized as investment income; the 20,000 1920 Donations (p9) cannot be traced to specific accounts on p17, so those stay student activity receipts.
